versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.4

- Enforced explicit confirmation for all registry write actions (e.g. push, message, order, payment-hold) through a new `--confirm` flag and strong warnings.
- Added `--allow-insecure-localhost` flag to permit non-HTTPS local registry usage; remote registries require HTTPS by default.
- Updated documentation and quick start guides to reflect new registry usage boundaries.
- Removed legacy skill-card documentation file.
- Improved security controls for public and private marketplace modes, with stricter enforcement against unconfirmed or insecure API activity.
Add money-line buyer, merchant, payment trust workflows and proxy evals.

Patch release: replace dynamic module loading in the registry with a normal same-directory import and keep the mai skill artifact lightweight. Paired with mai-plugin as the separate OpenClaw native bridge.

Patch release: republish mai as a lightweight skill-only package paired with the separate mai-plugin OpenClaw package. Keeps marketplace registry, auth, moderation, rate limiting, risk controls, PSP-backed custody records, and OpenClaw/Hermes install docs while excluding plugin source and tests from the skill artifact.

Release Mai as a marketplace registry skill paired with mai-plugin. Adds hosted discovery, merchant/buyer registry flows, API-key auth, role checks, moderation, risk scoring, rate limits, PSP-backed custody records, and OpenClaw/Hermes install docs.
Reposition mai as the broad natural-language shopping entry point alongside China Commerce Copilot.
